Dear Miss Yonge	
The end of the [M.S](/book/72). reached [me](/person/379) with your letter. I at once sent it to the Printer. Whatever alteration you may wish to make either in [illegible] or modifying can be done in the proof.
[Miss Martin](/person/971) - whom I saw yesterday - agreed with me in this.
Yours very [illegible]
Geo Lillie Craik
